assay_context.competition: Kd1 (user-confirmed assay name): CypA competition NanoBRET, CypA_NLN, RMC0727964 tracer, HEK293T_CYPA_KO
assay_context.competition_metric: Source GMean qAC50 (µM); Kd1 names the assay, not a reported dissociation constant.
assay_context.trfret_metric: Source qAC50 [M] converted to µM; source Sinf units unspecified.
assay_context.replicate_type: TR-FRET replicates are labelled Rep 1/Rep 2; biological versus technical is not specified.

notes: Full compound IDs, including batch suffixes, are matched exactly; batch variants are never merged.
TR-FRET results come from independently ID-labelled blocks in TR-FRET Data, not row positions across blocks.
The combined summary has many 30 µM / 0 entries where detailed TR-FRET rows are absent. These summary-only entries are not imported as measured TR-FRET results.
Blank detailed Sinf remains missing even where the combined summary contains zero.
TR-FRET export has no qualifier or fit-QC columns. Values near 30 µM are preserved as reported, without inferring an exact potency or a greater-than qualifier.
Primary-screen, mastersheet mean/GMean summaries, GDS source fits and per-replicate refits remain distinct.
Source hit labels and hit-list memberships are retained independently; blank labels do not establish inactivity.
